note: Names and hints only. Target coordinates have not been recovered; these are not imported as map markers.

quests.title: Golden Warrior
quests.hint: It is said that there's a brave warrior scarecrow...
quests.solution: The brave warrior scarecrow is the one in the Kokiri Shop.

quests.title: A Gauging Gaze
quests.hint: It is said there is one who lurks in the scorching heat, gauging the skill of warriors...
quests.solution: The one lurking in the scorching heat, gauging warriors' skills, was actually a stone statue in the Gerudo Proving Grounds.

quests.title: Moss Bench
quests.hint: It is said that moss sometimes makes the best bench...
quests.solution: The best bench is actually Mido's handmade moss bench.

quests.title: A Tribute to Rupees
quests.hint: It is said that there's a precious, priceless drawing...
quests.solution: The precious, priceless drawing is a Kokiri's depiction of rupees.

quests.title: The Sage's Perch
quests.hint: It is said that there is a place where those who possess wisdom descend...
quests.solution: The place where those who possess wisdom descend is Kaepora Gaebora's perch.

quests.title: Someone's Cart
quests.hint: It is said that fairies are drawn to hard workers...
quests.solution: The hard worker that attracted fairies is a cart placed in a field.

quests.title: Hyrule Royal Family's Stone Marker
quests.hint: It is said that a stone slab associated with the royal family lies in a place where remnants of castle walls stand...
quests.solution: The stone slab associated with the royal family, located among the remnants of the castle walls, stands quietly in Hyrule Field.

quests.title: Zora River Bridge
quests.hint: It is said that there is a bridge built to keep visitors' feet dry...
quests.solution: The lone bridge in Hyrule Field was built for visitors to Kakariko Village.

quests.title: Malanya
quests.hint: It is said that there is a being that is a horse—and yet, not a horse...
quests.solution: The true form of the horse that is not a horse is a handmade stuffed animal.

quests.title: Ranch Water Tower
quests.hint: It is said that there is a place where life-giving water is held...
quests.solution: The place where life-giving water is held is the ranch's water tower.

quests.title: A Girl's Memories
quests.hint: It is said that there is a place where you can catch a glimpse of a girl's memories...
quests.solution: The place where you can catch a glimpse of a girl's memories is Malon's room.

quests.title: A Guide to the Wind
quests.hint: It is said that giant whirling blades exist on the plains...
quests.solution: The giant whirling blades actually belong to the weather vane at Lon Lon Ranch.

quests.title: Fancy Sign
quests.hint: It is said that there is a fancy sign crafted by a tough-looking person...
quests.solution: The fancy sign turned out to be a welcome sign made by the Bazaar owner.

quests.title: Mask Shop Information Board
quests.hint: Apparently, there's a sign with some incredibly strange writing on it...
quests.solution: The sign with incredibly strange writing on it is the sign in the Happy Mask Shop.

quests.title: Overindulgent Guy
quests.hint: It is said that there is the laziest Hylian in Hyrule...
quests.solution: The laziest Hylian in Hyrule is the guy in the castle town who ate too much and couldn't move.

quests.title: A Mother's House
quests.hint: Apparently, there is a house built for a dog somewhere...
quests.solution: The house built for a dog is the home of Richard's owner.

quests.title: Li'l Miss Moo in the Valley
quests.hint: A deep moo echoes through the valley. The source of that sound is...
quests.solution: The deep mooing echoing through the valley is a cow secretly kept by a Gerudo.

quests.title: Witness to War
quests.hint: It is said that there is a silent witness to a land's rise and fall.
quests.solution: The silent witness to a land's rise and fall was a single tree that endured the ravages of war.

quests.title: Rules for Target Practice
quests.hint: Apparently, there's something that offers rules for playing...
quests.solution: The rules for playing come from the information board at the Shooting Gallery.

quests.title: A Bird's Song
quests.hint: It is said that there is a rare bird that tells the time...
quests.solution: The bird that tells time is a stone sculpture over the castle gate.

quests.title: A Cute, Unusual Visitor
quests.hint: It is said that a new resident has moved into Kokiri Forest...
quests.solution: The new resident of Kokiri Forest is a cow, a gift from Malon.

quests.title: The Royal Garden Fountain
quests.hint: It is said that there is a spring imbued with a wish for peace...
quests.solution: That spring, imbued with a wish for peace, was the fountain located in Hyrule Castle.

quests.title: A Big Bite!
quests.hint: Apparently, there's a fish with a mouth big enough to swallow a child...
quests.solution: The fish with the mouth big enough to swallow a child turned out to be the fish on the sign for a Fishing Pond.

quests.title: Weather Vane atop the Tower
quests.hint: Apparently, there is a suspicious device that keeps moving even though there's no wind...
quests.solution: This suspicious device that keeps moving even without wind was the weather vane at the Lakeside Laboratory.

quests.title: Beware of Wild Creatures!
quests.hint: It is said that there is a strange, bloodthirsty creature waiting in deep, dark waters.
quests.solution: The creature from the dark depths of the ocean was a ferocious shark.

quests.title: The Thing in the Tank
quests.hint: It is said that there is a mysterious thing in a tank, and that thing has eight wriggling tentacles...
quests.solution: Those eight tentacles belonged to an octopus that the lake scientist was researching.

quests.title: Ferryboat
quests.hint: It is said that, somewhere in this world, there's a ship that never floats...
quests.solution: The ship that never floats is a fishing-pond ferryboat that never gets any customers.

quests.title: Spirit of Hospitality
quests.hint: It is said that there is a note from Impa expressing her hospitality...
quests.solution: That note from Impa was on a banner in Kakariko Village.

quests.title: A Witness of the Sheikah
quests.hint: It is said that a Sheikah relic remains...
quests.solution: That Sheikah relic was the watchtower in Kakariko Village.

quests.title: Cursed Mansion
quests.hint: It is said that there is a house haunted by spiders...
quests.solution: The house haunted by spiders was the cursed home of a wealthy man.

quests.title: A Kid's Favorite
quests.hint: It is said that there is a secluded forest, far from civilization, where the playful sound of a flute echoes...
quests.solution: The playful sound of the flute was echoing from the Skull Kid's clearing in the Lost Woods.

quests.title: The Carpenter's Best Friend
quests.hint: Apparently, there's something called a "carpenter's best friend."
quests.solution: A carpenter's best friend is, in fact, a carpenter's tools.

quests.title: Weather-Vane Bird
quests.hint: It is said that there is a cucco watching over the village...
quests.solution: The cucco watching over the village was actually a weather vane on a roof.

quests.title: An Unnamed Master
quests.hint: It is said that there is a one-of-a-kind special cucco...
quests.solution: That one-of-a-kind special cucco was actually a child's scribble in Kakariko Village.

quests.title: The Grave Where Flat the Younger Rests
quests.hint: It is said that a composer who has lingering feelings for this world wanders around...
quests.solution: The wandering composer was Flat the Younger, who served the Hyrule royal family.

quests.title: Li'l Miss Moo at the Fortress
quests.hint: It is said that there is a cow-like horse beloved by a particular Gerudo...
quests.solution: It turns out that the cow-like horse beloved by a particular Gerudo was a normal cow in the horse stable.

quests.title: Gravekeeper's Diary
quests.hint: It is said that someone's secrets lie hidden where souls rest...
quests.solution: Dampé's diary was found in the place where souls rest.

quests.title: Former Gravekeeper's Diary
quests.hint: It is said that a secret is hidden in an abandoned building...
quests.solution: Dampé's diary was the secret hidden in the abandoned building.

quests.title: Gravekeeper's Resting Place
quests.hint: It is said that, at night, something glows eerily...
quests.solution: The source of the mysterious glow was Dampé's grave.

quests.title: The Throat of the Fire Dragon
quests.hint: It is said that beyond the throat of the fire dragon, one will be consumed by the scorching heat...
quests.solution: The throat of the fire dragon was the final gate leading to the crater of Death Mountain.

quests.title: The Fish Guardians
quests.hint: It is said that there are three fish that swim in the air...
quests.solution: The fish swimming in the air turned out to be carvings at the Fishing Pond.

quests.title: Ruby Pedestal
quests.hint: It is said that the Goron treasure is being targeted...
quests.solution: Fortunately, the Goron treasure was moved to a safe location.

quests.title: Warm Welcome to Goron City
quests.hint: It is said that there is a pointy sign in a hot spot...
quests.solution: That pointy sign was the stone slab at the entrance to Goron City.

quests.title: Dancing Vessel
quests.hint: It is said that there is a giant Goron with three faces...
quests.solution: The giant Goron with three faces was the giant vessel located in Goron City.

quests.title: Frog Stage
quests.hint: It is said that there is a stage for little musicians...
quests.solution: That stage for little musicians is actually the home of frogs who love to sing.

quests.title: Before a Deity
quests.hint: It seems there's a place for the Zora to offer prayers...
quests.solution: The place where the Zora offer prayers to a deity was a mosaic of Lord Jabu-Jabu.

quests.title: Lucky Zora Fish
quests.hint: Supposedly a fish created by the Zora princess exists somewhere in this world...
quests.solution: The fish supposedly created by the Zora princess was actually a sign for a Zora shop.

quests.title: Mocking Fishy Shadows
quests.hint: It is said that there is a suspicious-looking Zora carrying a bottle...
quests.solution: It turned out that the suspicious-looking Zora was hunting fish.

quests.title: Guardian of Water
quests.hint: It is said that the symbol of the Zora tribe is displayed above the Zora king's head...
quests.solution: What was displayed above the Zora king's head was the Zora crest.

quests.title: The Gate of Silence
quests.hint: It is said that a wall of snow sealed the fairies' secret passage, and they all fled, shivering in the cold.
quests.solution: The fairies' invisible secret passage was a small ruin in the snow-covered Zora Fountain.

quests.title: Kids' Favorite
quests.hint: It is said that a stage deep in the woods awaits a challenger...
quests.solution: The stage awaiting a challenger was the Skull Kids' tree trunk in the Lost Woods.

quests.title: Old Man of the Grove
quests.hint: It is said that within the Sacred Grove, there is a life that is drawing to a close...
quests.solution: The life drawing to a close in the Sacred Grove is an old tree.

quests.title: A Meal for Carpenters
quests.hint: They say there is a tantalizing dish that makes you break into a sweat with just one bite and becomes impossible to stop eating after a second bite...
quests.solution: The tantalizing dish that makes you break into a sweat with just one bite and becomes impossible to stop eating after a second bite turned out to be the meal cooked by the master craftsman.

quests.title: Today's Cooking Duty
quests.hint: Apparently, there's a hidden dish that makes you break out in a sweat just by smelling it and awakens your entire body with a single taste...
quests.solution: The hidden dish that makes you break out in a sweat just by smelling it and awakens your entire body with a single taste was a Gerudo meal.

quests.title: Throne of Schemes
quests.hint: It is said that there's a special chair engraved with a symbol that represents the sun...
quests.solution: The special chair engraved with a symbol that represents the sun was Ganondorf's chair in his war room.

quests.title: Merciless Iron Door
quests.hint: Apparently, there's a door that, once walked through, does not allow you to return...
quests.solution: The door that, once walked through, does not allow you to return was for the prison in Gerudo Fortress.

quests.title: Sand Tower Altar
quests.hint: It is said that wriggling gold lies near an altar hidden deep within the sandstorm...
quests.solution: The wriggling gold near an altar hidden deep within the sandstorm turned out to be a Gold Skulltula.

quests.title: Veterans' Allies
quests.hint: It is said that there are those who carry the stories of brave Gerudo warriors...
quests.solution: Those who carry the stories of brave Gerudo warriors are well-worn archery targets.

quests.title: A Shop Not on the Map
quests.hint: It is said that numerous witnesses have seen a strange figure floating in a vast mirage...
quests.solution: The floating figure was the carpet-riding merchant.

quests.title: A Drop of Blessing
quests.hint: Apparently, there's a place where the evil deity's tears fell...
quests.solution: The place where the evil deity's tears fell was an oasis in the desert.

quests.title: The Timid Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one guarding children from the shadowy grass joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The one guarding children from the shadowy grass was a gossip stone in Kokiri Forest.

quests.title: The Ripple Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one gazing at the ripples on the water's surface joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The one gazing at the ripples on the water's surface was a gossip stone standing at the base of an old tree on Lake Hylia.

quests.title: The Shade Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one loitering in the sunlight filtering through the large trees joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one loitering in the sunlight filtering through the large trees was a gossip stone that quietly watches over the Great Deku Tree.

quests.title: The Storyteller Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one nestling close to the forest's storyteller joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one nestling close to the forest's storyteller was a gossip stone standing next to the Great Deku Tree.

quests.title: The Lost Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one beckoning the lost joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The one beckoning the lost was a gossip stone in the Lost Woods.

quests.title: The Reverberating Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear stream flowing from the depths of the earth joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear stream flowing from the depths of the earth was a gossip stone standing in a hidden hole in the Zora River.

quests.title: The Inviting Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one who guides travelers to the recesses of a deep forest joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one guiding travelers to the recesses of a deep forest was a gossip stone that gazes beyond a sanctuary.

quests.title: The Hospitable Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one who welcomes guests in the deep forest joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one welcoming guests in the deep forest was a gossip stone loitering in a sanctuary.

quests.title: The Sanctuary Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one watching over the sanctuary joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one watching over the sanctuary was a gossip stone standing at the entrance to the Forest Temple.

quests.title: The Lake Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one watching over the lake joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one watching over the lake was a gossip stone that gazes out over Lake Hylia.

quests.title: The Watcher Held Captive by Spiders
quests.hint: It is said that the one held captive by the spiders in the depths still joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one being held captive by spiders in the depths of the earth was a gossip stone in a hidden hole in a field.

quests.title: The Aloof Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the aloof one that surrendered its body to the water joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The aloof one that surrendered its body to the water was a gossip stone that washed ashore on a small island.

quests.title: The Watcher Awaiting the Sound of Footsteps
quests.hint: It is said that the one who awaits visitors in the sanctuary that light cannot reach joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one awaiting visitors in a sanctuary which light cannot reach was a gossip stone in a hidden hole.

quests.title: The Bee Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one surrounded by a dangerously sweet scent joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one surrounded by a dangerously sweet scent was a gossip stone in a retreat for bees.

quests.title: The Horse-Loving Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one listening carefully to the sounds of horse hooves from the depths of the earth joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one listening carefully to the sounds of horse hooves from the depths of the earth was a gossip stone in a hidden hole in Hyrule Field.

quests.title: The Gossip-Loving Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one listening carefully for gossip from the depths of the earth joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one listening carefully for gossip from the depths of the earth was a gossip stone in a hidden hole in Hyrule Field.

quests.title: The Sorrow-Speaking Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one speaking of quiet sorrow joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one speaking of quiet sorrow was a gossip stone standing in Castle Town.

quests.title: The Delight-Speaking Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one who speaks of quiet delight joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one speaking of quiet delight was a gossip stone standing in Castle Town.

quests.title: The Anger-Speaking Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one speaking of quiet anger joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The one speaking of quiet anger was a gossip stone standing in Castle Town.

quests.title: The Joy-Speaking Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one speaking of quiet joy joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one speaking of quiet joy was a gossip stone standing in Castle Town.

quests.title: The Hidden-Stone Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that an observer unknown to even those of the royal family joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: An observer unknown to even those of the royal family was a gossip stone in a hidden hole within Hyrule Castle.

quests.title: The Evaluating Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one taking stock of the royal family's guests joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one taking stock of the royal family's guests was a gossip stone that took up position beside the gate to Hyrule Castle.

quests.title: The Wisteria-Trellis Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one gazing at the wisteria flowers joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The one gazing at the wisteria flowers was a gossip stone near the wisteria trellis in Hyrule Castle.

quests.title: The Reclusive Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one hiding in a Sheikah village joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one hiding in a Sheikah village was a gossip stone in a hidden hole in Kakariko Village.

quests.title: The Shadow Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one blending into the dark night joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The one blending into the dark night was a gossip stone standing at the entrance to the Shadow Temple.

quests.title: The Mountain-Climbing Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one escaping the rain of volcanic rocks joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one escaping the rain of volcanic rocks was a gossip stone standing on the Death Mountain Trail.

quests.title: The Cow-Protecting Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one watching over a traveler wandering about in the dark joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one watching over a traveler wandering about in the dark was a gossip stone in a hidden hole along a mountain trail.

quests.title: The Rock-Spring Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one lingering at the discovery of spring water flowing in a scorching-hot land joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one lingering at the discovery of spring water flowing in a scorching-hot land was a gossip stone in a hidden hole in a crater.

quests.title: The Flame Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one enduring obscurity in scorching heat joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The one enduring obscurity in scorching heat was a gossip stone standing in the crater of Death Mountain.

quests.title: The Goron Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the keen-eyed one lingering among the Gorons joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The keen-eyed one lingering among the Gorons was a gossip stone standing in Goron City.

quests.title: The Blacksmith Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one guarding the immovable one joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The one guarding the immovable one was a gossip stone standing beside Medigoron.

quests.title: The Meal Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one expressing interest in rock roast joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one expressing interest in rock roast was a gossip stone standing in Dodongo Cavern.

quests.title: The Clear-Stream Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear stream joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one listening carefully to the murmuring of a clear stream was a gossip stone standing on the Zora River.

quests.title: The Grotto Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one who listens carefully to the sounds of water running down bare rock joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one who listens carefully to the sounds of water running down bare rock was a gossip stone standing in a hidden hole on the Zora River.

quests.title: The Waterfall Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one refusing sleep joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one refusing sleep was a gossip stone standing below the Sleepless Waterfall.

quests.title: The History Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one residing by the folk of the water joyfully bounces up and down...
quests.solution: The one residing by the folk of the water was a gossip stone standing in Zora Domain.

quests.title: The Great Fairy Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one watching over the prospects of the Great Fairy joyfully wobbles from side to side...
quests.solution: The one watching over the prospects of the Great Fairy was a gossip stone in Zora Fountain.

quests.title: The Fountain Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one watching over the transience of a fountain joyfully spins and stretches...
quests.solution: The one watching over the transience of a fountain was a gossip stone standing in Zora Fountain.

quests.title: The Valley-Crossing Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one being washed by a spray of water at the floor of a red valley joyfully jumps to the skies...
quests.solution: The one being washed by a spray of water at the floor of a red valley was a gossip stone standing at the bottom of Gerudo Valley.

quests.title: The Heat-Haze Watcher
quests.hint: It is said that the one guarding the goddess of the sand joyfully surrenders to the hammer...
quests.solution: The one guarding the goddess of the sand was a gossip stone standing beside the Evil Desert Colossus.
